verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a silicon chip. Opting out of having user data used for AI training is a data-policy and account-control question for a service or software product, not a processor, so the axis is a category error. The evidence mentions on-device Apple Intelligence and local LLM execution, but nothing shows the chip itself ships any training opt-out control, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
